_about: Series bible in machine-readable form: episodes, shared vocabulary for the outlines, and the threads that run between episodes.
check_outline.py reads this file, cast.json, credits.json and math_objects.json, then checks every epN/outline.json against them.

paper.title: Kittens, MOGs, and mathematical blackjack
paper._comment: Outlines cite the paper by \label (stable across drafts), not by section number.

episodes.title: The Secret Code of the MINIMOG
The Hidden Graph of the Game

title_card._comment: Scene s00 of every episode plays a version of the series main title, then that episode's subtitle, both from the titles screenplay.  Text comes from this file, never from an outline, so a retitle happens in one place.

end_credits._comment: Scene s99 of every episode plays the end-credits screenplay (text from credits.json, voices from cast.json), then a tail card: 'next_time' for Episodes 1-3, 'finale' for Episode 4.

epistemic._comment: What a beat claims to do.  Only proof and exhaustive_check may carry 'establishes'.

visual_verbs._comment: Each 'visual' entry is verb or verb:argument.  These become cue types in epN/cues.json.
visual_verbs.title_card: Series and episode title on the episode's motif
visual_verbs.credits_text: A credits section appears in its card's staging
visual_verbs.card_deal: Cards travel from the deck to hand and pile
visual_verbs.card_exchange: One hand card and one pile card trade places
visual_verbs.total_counter: Running total of the hand, updating with each exchange
visual_verbs.flip_hand: Swap the hand and the pile (complement)
visual_verbs.branch_tree: Moves from a hand fan out as branches; replies hang below
visual_verbs.line_up: Hands set side by side for comparison
visual_verbs.highlight: Color a set of points, cards or cells
visual_verbs.summon_completion: Chosen points call forth the unique completing point or points
visual_verbs.reveal_count: A number builds up from its parts
visual_verbs.point_ring: Twelve labels on a circle, permuted by a map
visual_verbs.morph_layout: One labeled diagram turns into another, cell by cell
visual_verbs.fly_to_minimog: Cards fly into the 3 x 4 MINIMOG array
visual_verbs.clock_mod: A small modular clock (mod 3 or mod 11)
visual_verbs.assemble_codeword: A tetracode word builds from its two free coordinates
visual_verbs.write_along: Words travel along a curve or graph edge (Haynes technique)
visual_verbs.graph_grow: Vertices and edges appear outward from one hand
visual_verbs.orient_edges: Edges gain arrows toward lower totals
visual_verbs.probability_bar: Bar splitting deals into winning and losing
visual_verbs.point_at: A character points at an object on screen

threads._comment: Plants and payoffs.  Every thread must be set up before it is paid off, and every setup must be paid off somewhere.
threads.mystery_21_45: The hands {1..6} (total 21) and its complement (total 45) are both losing. Why?
threads.special_hands: The losing hands look special. What makes a set special?
threads.pascal_skill: Did Pascal win the first game by skill or by luck?
threads.move_7_to_5: Pascal's opening move 7 -> 5 in the worked game
threads.why_repair_wins: Repairing a hand to a hexad seems to win. Why does it always work?
threads.every_21_hexad: Every hand Pascal finds with total 21 is one of the special ones

concepts._comment: Ideas the films show and name.  check_outline.py enforces 'show it before you name it': a concept may be named only in or after a beat that shows it.
concepts.shared_hand: One visible six-card hand shared by both players
concepts.total: Sum of the card values in the hand
concepts.exchange: Swapping one hand card for a smaller pile card
concepts.threshold_21: The new total must be at least 21
concepts.normal_play: A player with no legal move loses
concepts.legal_move: An exchange that obeys the rules
concepts.set: A collection of cards, order ignored
concepts.complement: The six cards not in a hand
concepts.losing_position: A hand that loses for the player about to move, under best play
concepts.winning_position: A hand from which the player to move can force a win
concepts.experiment_vs_proof: Trying some moves is not the same as checking all of them
concepts.finite_geometry: A geometry with finitely many points
concepts.fano_plane: Seven points, seven lines, three points on each line
concepts.unique_completion: Two points lie on exactly one line
concepts.steiner_system: S(t,k,v): every t points lie in exactly one block of size k
concepts.hexad: A block of the small Witt design S(5,6,12)
concepts.projective_line: The residues mod 11 together with infinity
concepts.permutation: A rearrangement of the twelve labels
concepts.orbit: Everything reachable from the seed by the two moves
concepts.affine_plane_f3: A 3 x 3 grid whose rows, columns and wrapped diagonals are lines
concepts.curtis_kitten: Curtis's triangle of three affine views with corners
concepts.cross_square: A cross (two perpendicular lines) and the square left over
concepts.shuffle_labeling: The relabeling that turns points into card values
concepts.minimog: Conway's 3 x 4 array of the twelve cards
concepts.tetracode: Nine words (b, a, a+b, a+2b) mod 3
concepts.two_determine_word: Any two coordinates of a tetracode word determine it
concepts.odd_man_out: Reading a row from each column of a hand
concepts.wildcard: An empty or full column, which fits any row
concepts.forbidden_counts: Column counts 0, 1, 2, 3 rule a hand out
concepts.repair: A one-card exchange that turns a nonhexad into a hexad
concepts.golay_code: The ternary Golay code behind the signed patterns (optional)
concepts.vertex_edge: Hands as dots, exchanges as lines
concepts.johnson_graph: J(12,6): all six-card hands, joined when they share five cards
concepts.max_independent: No independent set in J(12,6) is larger than 132 (optional)
concepts.equitable_partition: Every nonhexad has 6 hexad neighbors; every hexad has 36 nonhexad neighbors
concepts.quotient_matrix: The 2 x 2 matrix of those neighbor counts
concepts.directed_graph: Edges pointed toward the lower total
concepts.acyclic: Totals fall, so no move sequence returns to a hand
concepts.recursion: Decide hands in order of increasing total
concepts.kernel: A set with no moves inside it that every other position can move into
concepts.redeal_probability: Chance of a winning deal when low hands are redealt
